Research Interests

Development & Connectomics

Segregation and integration of functional networks in early childhood, and the spatiotemporal organization of cortical functional hierarchy across the lifespan.

Learning & Neuroplasticity

How experience, including musical training, reshapes dynamic brain network organization and structural and functional connectivity in auditory–motor systems.

Aging & Brain Disorders

Multimodal neuroimaging of memory and brain network organization in temporal lobe epilepsy, mild cognitive impairment, and related conditions.
